## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Villers-Cotterêts, France. It starts at Rue Viollet le Duc.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Knights on white horses, swashbuckling invaders and a creaking drawbridge, you can imagine it all in action here at Château de Pierrefonds. But this ex-imperial residence for Napoleon III was actually redesigned in the style of the Middle Ages, just for him!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €9.85. It was rated 4.7 out of 5 from 232 ratings and 127 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
